data.summary: Weibo Corp (NASDAQ: WB) reported fiscal first-quarter results on Wednesday. The company reported quarterly revenue of $396.9 million, up 0.34% year-on-year, beating the analyst consensus estimate of $394.2 million. The Chinese microblogging social network company’s revenue grew 1% Y/Y on a constant basis. Adjusted EPS of 45 cents beat the analyst consensus estimate of 38 cents.
